DIAGNOSIS READY: Upper Airway Cough Syndrome (Postnasal Drip) due to allergic rhinitis.

The normal chest X-ray and upper GI series, combined with positive allergy testing and worsening nighttime symptoms, strongly point to postnasal drip from allergic rhinitis as the primary cause of your chronic cough. I recommend starting an antihistamine and nasal corticosteroid spray to manage your symptoms.
